content: Head to the farmer’s market now; the best produce will be gone within the hour.
Is it really that busy this early?
Yes, and you missed the peaches last time by arriving late.
Do they still have that fresh bread stall?
Yes—go now before their sourdough sells out.
Okay, I’ll grab my shopping bag and head over.
Bring cash—some stalls don’t take cards.
Thanks, I’ll be there in 15 minutes.
